correctness.rationale: For a fixed feasible pattern, contract each prescribed same-colour directed path to a block, giving exactly 1/(n)_{e_A}(n)_{e_B}. In mixed factorial moments disjoint ordered occurrences supply the product of inverse coloured automorphism orders. A component containing two distinct overlapping cycles has multigraph excess at least one, while other cycle components have nonnegative excess. A bounded union with v vertices and positive excess contributes O(n^v n^(-e))=O(n^-1), proving the joint Poisson claim including parallel two-cycles. For the locality step one may exclude all bounded connected bicyclic patterns of size sufficient to cover the outer 2R neighborhood of any short core, not merely pairs of cycles each of length <=2R+1; all such bad patterns have positive excess. An endpoint mark requires its path block to be first or last in its colour, giving an extra O(1/n) per endpoint constraint. If first and last are prescribed in the same block then the event is impossible for large n; otherwise two endpoint constraints cost O(n^-2), including across colours by independence. Thus a bounded cycle joined to an endpoint or bounded connecting tree with two marked endpoints is negligible. An induced non-tree R-ball has a cycle of length <=2R+1 by a breadth-first tree plus a non-tree edge (including a parallel arc). On the good event the local contributions are the deterministic rooted types in port-labelled tree completions of one core at a time, with the generic tree type saturating; each cycle count can itself be clipped at the Hanf threshold. The finitely many attainable vectors can be enumerated from these templates; each has positive limiting probability from the independent positive-mean Poisson variables and is therefore represented by a finite pair of paths. Enumerating finite pairs to find a representative for each vector terminates. Rational Poisson means and finite combinations of their clipped masses give the asserted ring with a computable common denominator. For the coherently directed alternating cycle of length 2m only even rotations preserve colour, including the m=1 parallel-edge case, so finite sums of distinct reciprocal integers give the dense set as stated. Reviewed RESULT.md:23–50, VERIFICATION.md and check_successor_local_law.py. The checker concerns four finite first moments, was not rerun and is not needed for the asymptotic proof. The result is for the successor reduct only, with fixed formulas.

evidence: The cyclic-successor plus matching model has the same Poisson-core formula 1/|Aut|, Hanf locality, arithmetic field and density package. The two-uniform-involution model gives the same arithmetic and density conclusions via different components. The proper ternary path model uses finite-state mixing and endpoint-word locality.
Jeż–Michaliszyn–Witkowski have finite satisfiability and model-size results for two-variable logic with multiple successors, not a random-measure convergence theorem.
broader_coverage.reasoning: These comparisons credit the established proof template and related logical strengths. A fixed cycle plus uniform matching, an involution, and a finite-state path model do not specialize to two independent uniform Hamiltonian paths with four isolated endpoint defects. Satisfiability does not determine frequencies.

originality.rationale: The exact-model earlier theorem covers quantifier rank two (even for more colours), and earlier results for other random structures supply much of the proof architecture including Poisson cores, Hanf reduction and density. The distinct result is the extension to every quantifier rank in the two-path model, with its full short-coloured-cycle family and treatment of the four endpoints. No inspected stronger theorem implies the complete result for these two independently sampled Hamiltonian paths.
residual_risks: A more general result about coloured random configurations conditioned to be Hamiltonian might provide an implication; none was verified in the bounded Resultary and primary OA comparisons. Historical priority is not certified.

value.rationale: The theorem identifies exactly what is gained by retaining only successors in a model known not to converge in its full-order signature. It gives a full effective law rather than only an example sentence or bounded-rank list, explains the endpoint and cycle contributions, and quantifies how much variation remains through the arithmetic and density conclusions. The close matching and involution analogues are creditable precedents, but they do not settle these model-specific questions.
